content.title: About
content.content: Greens is a blend of frozen leafy vegetables (spinach, broccoli, kale, green peas) that have been blanched and have added plant fat to improve flavor and texture. The product is ready to eat after heating and is ideal for quick meal preparation.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The mix contains at least five different leafy vegetables, providing a broad spectrum of nutrients.
Added fat enhances absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins A, D, E and K.
Freezing preserves most vitamins and minerals, comparable to fresh vegetables.
Often used in fast‑food kitchens and ready‑meal production to save time.
Greens can be stored in the freezer for up to 12 months without quality loss.

items.title: Rich in vitamin K
items.content: Vitamin K is essential for blood clotting and bone health.

items.title: Contains vitamin A and carotenoids
items.content: Support vision, immune function, and skin health.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Phytonutrients
items.content: Antioxidants such as lutein and zeaxanthin protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Fat improves nutrient absorption
items.content: The added plant fat helps the body better absorb fat‑soluble vitamins.

items.title: Allergy to plant oils
items.content: The product may contain soy or sunflower oil, which can trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Some versions are lightly salted; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: Leafy greens can contain oxalates, which may contribute to kidney stone formation in susceptible individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat Greens in the microwave or skillet for 3–5 minutes, add to soups, stews, pasta, or use as a base for vegetable patties. Enhance with spices, soy sauce, or cheese for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen at –18 °C in the original packaging. Once thawed, consume within 24 hours and do not refreeze.
